releases.body: Fixed to work with Outer Wilds Patch 15 (updated game libs).
releases.bodyZh: 修复以支持星际拓荒补丁15（更新了游戏库）。

releases.body:
Fix issues with shutdown situations (ship electrical systems damaged) in unexpected states. Particularly, it prevents a softlock when editing an entry name or description (it also saves the changes made on them).

Thank you @QuantumBlur314 for reporting this bug!
releases.bodyZh:
修复在意外状态下（飞船电力系统损坏）的关机问题。特别是，它防止在编辑条目名称或描述时出现软锁（它还会保存所做的更改）。

感谢 @QuantumBlur314 报告此错误！

releases.body: Fix middle prompts not showing after Outer Wilds Patch 14 (upper right prompts are already visible after the last Custom Ship Log Modes update)
releases.bodyZh: 修复在星际拓荒14补丁后中间提示不显示的问题（在最近的定制飞船日志模式更新后右上角的提示已经可见）

releases.body:
- Added an orange cursor with a "+" shape controllable with the mouse when editing input fields (entry names and descriptions) that can be used to select text or change the caret position.
- Added the option to discard the changes made to an input field (pressing esc while holding shift)., which restores the entry name/description to the value it was before editing the text.
releases.bodyZh:
- 添加了一个带有"+"形状的橙色光标，可通过鼠标控制，用于在编辑输入字段（条目名称和描述）时选择文本或更改光标位置。
- 添加了放弃对输入字段所做的更改的选项（按住Shift键的同时按下Esc键），这将将条目名称/描述恢复到编辑文本之前的值。

releases.body: Shows an error item in the description field and a red "X" in the photo square if the image of the selected entry isn't found in Épicas Album (because it was deleted). Before this, it just displayed a white image. The error message includes the name of the missing snapshot.
releases.bodyZh: 若在《史诗相册》中找不到所选条目的图像（因为它被删除了），则在描述字段中显示一个错误项，并在照片方格中显示一个红色的“X”。在此之前，它只是显示一个白色图像。错误消息包括丢失的快照的名称。
